complexity: O(n) to generate rows; O(n log n) for top-N sort

--seed -> generate_rows (synthetic table)
subcommand: summary | top | filter -> formatted table or JSON
description_sentence: A subcommand CLI that generates seeded synthetic topic rows and reports summaries, top-N rows, or filtered rows as tables or JSON.
failure_note: An empty filter result prints a zero-count table rather than erroring; --top-n larger than the row count simply returns all rows.

label: Command-line tool

pitch_sentence: A {topic} command-line tool with summary, top-N, and filter subcommands that works on reproducible seeded data and emits tables or JSON.

qa.a: It prints the summary table, so `python3 src/main.py` alone is a complete demo.
qa.q: What runs when no subcommand is given?

resume_bullet_template: Built a {topic} CLI tool in Python (argparse subcommands) over seeded synthetic data with table and JSON output; runs summary, top-N, and filter reports deterministically.
run_notes: Try `python3 src/main.py top --top-n 3`, `python3 src/main.py filter --min-value 900`, or add --json to any command.
scaling_note: Rows live in a Python list, so memory grows linearly with --rows; fine for tens of thousands of rows on a laptop.
storage_note: No persistence: rows are regenerated from the seed on every invocation and nothing is written to disk.
tradeoff_note: Synthetic seeded data keeps the tool self-contained and reproducible, at the cost of not reading real input files.
